conditions: applies to the individual policy issued on conversion
expected.notes: The Master Policy itself is renewed annually; lifelong renewal is stated only for the converted individual policy.
expected.quote: The individual policy issued on conversion under Clause F.5 shall be renewable for life, subject to the grounds of fraud and misrepresentation stated above.

expected.valueText: Renewal may be refused only on grounds of fraud, misrepresentation or non-disclosure of material facts; renewal is not denied because claims were made
expected.quote: Renewal may be refused only on grounds of fraud, misrepresentation or non-disclosure of material facts.

expected.valueText: The Master Policy is renewed annually on the request of the Policyholder received before the expiry date
expected.quote: The Master Policy is renewed annually on the request of the Policyholder received before the expiry date.
Claims arising in the grace period after expiry shall not be covered.
Base premium: Rs. 78,000 per policy year. GST at 18%: Rs. 14,040. Total premium: Rs. 92,040.
Base premium: Rs. 78,000 per policy year.

expected.valueText: 15% loading on base premium on account of declared type 2 diabetes
expected.quote: A loading of 15% on the base premium has been applied for Insured Person Vikram Verma on account of declared type 2 diabetes.
Premium discounts applicable: online purchase discount of 5% and long-term discount of 7.5% on the base premium.

expected.valueText: Premium for dependent parents is determined on the age band of each parent at inception of the certificate and changes when a parent enters a higher age band at renewal
expected.quote: Premium for dependent parents is determined on the age band of each parent at inception of the certificate, and the premium changes when a parent enters a higher age band at renewal.

expected.valueText: Premium rates may be revised only with prior IRDAI approval and apply from the next renewal after notice to the Policyholder; no Insured Person is loaded on renewal for his or her own claims
expected.quote: The premium rates may be revised only with the prior approval of the IRDAI, and the revised premium shall apply from the next renewal after notice to the Policyholder. No Insured Person shall be loaded on renewal on the ground of his or her own claims.

expected.valueText: Changes to policy terms take effect only after IRDAI approval and 3 months written notice to the Policyholder
expected.quote: Changes to the terms of this policy shall take effect only after approval of the IRDAI and written notice of 3 months to the Policyholder.

expected.valueText: Sum insured may be enhanced at renewal on the Policyholder's request, subject to underwriting; waiting periods apply afresh to the enhanced portion
expected.quote: The sum insured may be enhanced at renewal on the request of the Policyholder, subject to underwriting, and the waiting periods shall apply afresh to the enhanced portion.

expected.valueText: A member who ceases to be an employee, with covered dependents, may apply for an individual health policy without fresh medical underwriting, with continuous cover credited towards waiting periods
expected.quote: An Insured Person who ceases to be an employee of the Policyholder, and the dependents covered with him or her, may apply to the Company for an individual health policy without a fresh medical underwriting, and the period of continuous cover under this Master Policy shall be credited towards waiting periods.

conditions: counted from the date of leaving employment
expected.quote: The application must be made within 30 days of the date of leaving employment.

expected.valueText: On withdrawal of the product the Policyholder is informed and Insured Persons are offered migration to a suitable product with continuity benefits preserved
expected.quote: If the Company withdraws this product, the Policyholder shall be informed and the Insured Persons shall be offered migration to a suitable product with continuity benefits preserved.

conditions: no refund if a claim has been made
expected.quote: the Company shall refund the premium as per the short period scale below.

expected.valueText: Period on risk up to 1 month: refund 75% of premium; up to 3 months: 50%; up to 6 months: 25%; above 6 months: no refund
expected.quote: Period on risk up to 1 month: refund of 75% of premium; up to 3 months: 50%; up to 6 months: 25%; above 6 months: no refund.

expected.valueText: The Company may cancel on grounds of fraud, misrepresentation or non-cooperation by giving 30 days written notice and refunds the premium for the unexpired period
expected.quote: The Company may cancel the policy on grounds of fraud, misrepresentation or non-cooperation by giving 30 days' written notice, and shall refund the premium for the unexpired period.
Premium is payable annually in advance by the Policyholder.
Premium may be paid by cheque, NEFT/RTGS or online payment.

conditions: individual policy purchased for a 2-year term
expected.quote: Where the individual policy is purchased for a 2-year term, a multi-year discount of 7.5% on the premium shall be allowed.

expected.valueText: Premium paid may be eligible for deduction under Section 80D of the Income-tax Act, 1961, subject to the tax laws in force and to payment by a mode other than cash
expected.quote: Premium paid may be eligible for deduction under Section 80D of the Income-tax Act, 1961, subject to the tax laws in force and to payment by a mode other than cash.
